note: Report 0009, Q14: the land around the play area on the horizon (Long Hải, Núi Dinh, Cần Giờ), a far mesh from the Copernicus DEM. tools/geo/fetch.py --only mainland reads the window (radius_m around the middle of the box, at pixel_arcsec), and tools/geo/build.py makes the grid of grid_m (data/geo/build/mainland.json): the cells out of the box of the play area that have land, with the curve of the earth (refraction: the part of the curve that the air gives back).
